status.scope: Final T25 platform manual for the current dApp before testnet dress rehearsal and final mainnet cutover.

mainnetBlockers.title: T26 testnet dress rehearsal is not yet complete
mainnetBlockers.description: The full create/deposit/route/rebalance/coverage/governance/operator path still needs final production-like testnet evidence and transaction hashes.

mainnetBlockers.title: T27 final mainnet cutover is intentionally pending
mainnetBlockers.description: The repository must not claim 100% mainnet launch completion until canonical mainnet deployment, Vercel production env and post-deploy canary evidence are recorded.

mainnetBlockers.title: Production dependency audit has expiring SODAX transitive exceptions
mainnetBlockers.description: The production audit gate has zero unapproved high/critical blockers, but the current SODAX transitive exception policy remains explicitly documented and expiring.

claims.claim: Public product routes are separated from verified operator console routes.
DAO-governed mutations are classified and routed through governance policy instead of being silently exposed as arbitrary writes.
Smart Routing uses the broker-scale planner, benchmark gate and canary gate instead of static UI route claims.
Balanced/SODAX AUTO is documented as intent-surface evidence and not as a fabricated public router contract.
Soroban storage lifecycle and extension operations are documented as an operator runbook and script path.
Production deployment is blocked by a machine-consumable release gate until environment, oracle, routing, API, visual and audit posture are ready.
The manual screenshots are generated from the same Playwright route manifest used by the design audit.

screens.audience: Depositors, managers and operators reviewing the global product posture.
screens.purpose: Summarize indexed Arkas, manager posture, NAV history and public operating health from catalog-backed data.
screens.boundary: No wallet write is performed on this screen; unavailable history is shown explicitly instead of fabricated charts.

screens.audience: Users searching the indexed Arka, manager and asset universe.
screens.purpose: Search and filter the catalog before opening product profiles or execution routes.
screens.boundary: Discovery is read-only and does not sign transactions.

screens.audience: Users creating a new Arka through the guided wizard.
screens.purpose: Entry frame for the Figma-aligned Create Arka wizard before parameters are selected.
screens.boundary: No protocol strategy is configured during creation; execution actions happen after an Arka exists.

screens.audience: Arka creator.
screens.purpose: Collect the basic name, manager and denomination setup for a new Arka.
screens.boundary: Field validation happens before build/submit; no invented asset IDs are injected.

screens.audience: Arka creator.
screens.purpose: Configure management/performance fee posture with reviewable numeric inputs.
screens.boundary: Fee values are typed and validated before transaction payload construction.

screens.audience: Arka creator.
screens.purpose: Configure deposit policy, permitted wallet posture and deposit limits.
screens.boundary: Deposit policy is surfaced as creation policy, not as a post-hoc fake badge.

screens.audience: Arka creator.
screens.purpose: Configure redemption policy before final review.
screens.boundary: Redemption policy remains part of the deployment payload review path.

screens.audience: Arka creator.
screens.purpose: Select initial supported assets from the real registry with icons/metadata where available.
screens.boundary: Known assets are selected from registry data; unsupported assets are not presented as configured.

screens.audience: Arka creator.
screens.purpose: Review the complete creation payload before wallet signing.
actions: submit create transaction when wallet permits
screens.boundary: Review is explicit; the UI does not silently instantiate without payload visibility.

screens.audience: Users comparing Arkas before selecting one.
screens.purpose: Rank and filter Arkas by truthful catalog-backed metrics.
screens.boundary: This is review mode; deposits/rebalances live under /arkas/[id].

screens.audience: Users reviewing concentration and asset availability.
screens.purpose: Expose core Stellar assets and catalog-linked exposure without requiring raw contract IDs.
screens.boundary: Asset icons/metadata come from registry or stellar.toml/CDN fallbacks, not invented UI constants.

screens.audience: Users inspecting one Arka before live execution.
screens.purpose: Show the indexed product profile, manager, allocation and route posture.
screens.boundary: Profile mode is separate from live wallet-backed execution.

screens.audience: Users and operators reviewing supported protocol posture.
screens.purpose: Explain Aquarius, SoroSwap, Balanced/SODAX and Blend support status with runtime-backed evidence.
screens.boundary: Balanced/SODAX is shown as intent integration evidence, not as a fake router contract.

screens.audience: Users comparing manager mandate and reputation context.
screens.purpose: Rank managers using catalog-backed NAV, curated mandate and search signals.
screens.boundary: Manager reputation is read here; governed mutations are not performed from this public list.

screens.audience: Users inspecting one asset exposure.
screens.purpose: Show a selected asset's indexed exposure and linked Arkas.
screens.boundary: Asset detail is read-only and catalog-backed.

screens.audience: Users inspecting a core Stellar asset.
screens.purpose: Show the registry-backed asset profile for known Stellar assets such as XLM, USDC, AQUA, XTAR and BLND.
screens.boundary: When a core asset is not indexed in current catalog data, the UI says so instead of fabricating exposure.

screens.audience: Users evaluating one manager.
screens.purpose: Show manager mandate, linked Arkas and catalog-backed track context.
screens.boundary: Score/tier changes remain governed/operator actions outside this public profile.

screens.audience: Users and managers moving from product browsing into live Arka operations.
screens.purpose: Provide the operational entrypoint for known Arkas and clarify product-vs-execution route boundaries.
screens.boundary: This index launches execution but does not itself perform the write.

screens.audience: Wallet users and authorized managers operating one Arka.
screens.purpose: Deposit, redeem, rebalance and inspect credit/routing posture for one Arka.
screens.boundary: Writes require wallet flow, review and confirmation; protocol strategy is used here after creation.

screens.audience: Governance participants.
screens.purpose: Run proposal lifecycle operations: propose, vote, close and execute.
screens.boundary: Governance-sensitive writes belong here or in the verified DAO console; they do not bypass timelock/executor controls.

screens.audience: Members and operators reviewing reserve posture.
screens.purpose: Operate first-loss/reserve coverage actions and member reward posture.
screens.boundary: Coverage fund mutations require wallet confirmation and typed amount validation.

screens.audience: Operators checking runbook readiness.
screens.purpose: Show operational baselines, health checks and runbook status before risky actions.
screens.boundary: Ops is diagnostic; it does not pretend to close testnet/mainnet evidence by itself.

screens.audience: Operators performing low-level contract reads/writes under policy.
screens.purpose: Typed and raw contract interaction with mutation and storage matrices.
screens.boundary: DAO-governed writes are blocked or routed to governance; raw controls are not public product UI.

screens.audience: Operators verifying environment and contract wiring.
screens.purpose: Inspect runtime config, contract IDs and guarded rebalance settings.
screens.boundary: Settings is an inspection surface; changes to governed values require DAO flow.

screens.audience: Operators validating release readiness.
screens.purpose: Show release blockers, oracle cutover posture, routing gate status and known limits.
screens.boundary: Status can report readiness but cannot create missing mainnet evidence.

screens.audience: Operators and governance reviewers managing manager reputation posture.
screens.purpose: Inspect and apply tier/points posture where authorization and governance policy allow it.
screens.boundary: Manager reputation changes are governed/operator actions, not public leaderboard edits.

screens.audience: Operators preparing governed migrations.
screens.purpose: Inspect, simulate and prepare migration payloads before they are executed through approved governance/operator paths.
screens.boundary: Migration payloads are previewed and validated; final mainnet migration remains a governed/cutover operation.

screens.audience: Verified governance operators preparing executable DAO payloads.
screens.purpose: Compose and review governed action packages before proposal/execution lanes.
screens.boundary: The console prepares validated packages; it does not fabricate a generic Governor batch primitive if the contract does not expose one.

screens.audience: Operators validating protocol execution lanes.
screens.purpose: Inspect adapter evidence, quote/status/confirm posture and operator-only integration controls.
screens.boundary: Operator integration controls remain separate from public protocol overview and are wallet/operator-gated.
